title: Cactus Fruit
wikitext: {{Infobox |eng = Cactus Fruit |source = *[[Foraging]] in [[the Desert]] *[[Oasis]] |seed = {{Name|Cactus Seeds}} |season = All |growth = 12 days |xp = *[[Foraging]]: 7 [[Foraging]] XP *[[Cactus Seeds]]: 14 [[Farming]] XP *[[Oasis]]: N/A |sellprice = 75 |edibility = 30 |color = Green }} The '''Cactus Fruit''' is found via [[foraging]] in [[The Desert|the Calico Desert]]. It can also be bought at the [[Oasis]] on Tuesdays for {{Price|150}} or randomly at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|75}}. It can randomly be found in [[Garbage Can]]s after unlocking The Desert. The [[Statue Of Endless Fortune]] produces one Cactus Fruit per year on [[Sam]]'s birthday, [[Summer|Summer 17]]. Cactus Fruit may also be grown from [[Cactus Seeds]]. Cactus Fruit grown from Cactus Seeds benefits from the [[Farming#Farming Skill|Tiller Profession]] bonus. Cactus Fruit plants mature after 12 days and continue to produce every 3 days after maturity. ==Stages== {|class="wikitable roundedborder" style="text-align:center;" !Stage 1 !Stage 2 !Stage 3 !Stage 4 !Stage 5 !Harvest !After-Harvest |- |[[File:Cactus Stage 1.png|center|link=]] |[[File:Cactus Stage 2.png|center|link=]] |[[File:Cactus Stage 3.png|center|link=]] |[[File:Cactus Stage 4.png|center|link=]] |[[File:Cactus Stage 5.png|center|link=]] |[[File:Cactus Stage 6.png|center|link=]] |[[File:Cactus Stage 7.png|center|link=]] |- |2 Days |2 Days |2 Days |3 Days |3 Days |Total: 12 Days |Regrowth: 3 Days |- |} ==Crop Growth Calendar== {{#lst:Crop Growth Calendars|Cactus Fruit}} ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Lewis,Jodi,Kent,Leah,Shane,Elliott,Harvey,Sandy |neutral=Maru,Sebastian,Pierre,Caroline,Alex,George,Evelyn,Clint,Penny,Emily,Marnie,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Willy,Krobus,Leo |love=Linus,Pam,Sam |dislike=Abigail,Haley,Jas,Vincent }} ==Bundles== *Cactus Fruit is one of the options for the {{Bundle|Exotic Foraging||y}}. *Cactus Fruit may be an option for the {{Bundle|Dye Remixed||y}}. ==Recipes== Cactus Fruit is not used in any recipes. ==Buildings== Cactus Fruit is used to construct [[Desert Obelisk]]s purchased from the [[Wizard's Tower]]. {|class="wikitable sortable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description !Cost !Size |- |[[File:Desert Obelisk.png|60px|center]] |[[Desert Obelisk]] |{{Description|Desert Obelisk}} |{{Price|1000000}}{{Name|Iridium Bar|20}}{{Name|Coconut|10}}{{Name|Cactus Fruit|10}} |style="text-align: center;"|'''3x2'''[[File:Marker3x2.png|center|3x2]] |} ==Tailoring== Cactus Fruit is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a dyeable [[Tailoring|80's Shirt]]. *Female version: [[File:Shirt136.png|24px]] *Male version: [[File:Shirt152.png|24px]] It is a green dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the green dye pot at Emily's and Haley's house for use in [[dyeing]]. ==Quests== *Cactus Fruit may be randomly requested after the player has completed the [[Bundles#Vault|Vault Bundles]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|225}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points. *3 Cactus Fruit may be requested by [[Sandfish]] or [[Scorpion Carp]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 3 to 5. ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.3.27|Added ability to grow from [[Cactus Seeds]].}} {{History|1.4|Added [[Desert Obelisk]] building requirement.
